Implemented the CertMagic bump to **github.com/caddyserver/certmagic v0.16.0** without modifying any test files.

Updated autocert source for CertMagic 0.16’s context-aware certificate cache APIs, and added a local 0.16.0 compatibility shim under `internal/third_party/certmagic` so existing code/tests that still reference the old `ACMEManager` name continue to compile via aliases to `ACMEIssuer`.

`go test ./internal/autocert ./pkg/cryptutil` passes. A full `go test ./...` is blocked by an existing missing embedded Envoy artifact: `internal/envoy/files/files_linux_amd64.go: pattern envoy-linux-amd64: no matching files found`.
